title: Evidence-Grounded SLM Behavioral Prediction Architecture for Future Assistance Use
abstract: arXiv:2610.32193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Users often exhibit changes in interaction behavior before explicitly seeking assistance, enabling systems to anticipate future assistance use. This is especially important in high-stakes environments, where delayed assistance can have operational, financial, or safety consequences. However, conventional Large Language Models (LLMs) are often unsuitable for continuous on-device behavioral prediction because of their computational and memory demands. Behavioral patterns are also highly individual and device-specific, motivating local processing that preserves privacy and data sovereignty. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative, but their ability to reason reliably over low-level sequential interaction events remains underexplored. translated_title: 面向未来辅助使用的证据驱动型小型语言模型（SLM）行为预测架构
translated_abstract: 用户在明确寻求帮助之前，通常会表现出交互行为的变化，这使系统能够预测未来的辅助使用需求。这在高风险环境中尤为重要，因为延迟的辅助可能带来运营、财务或安全方面的后果。然而，传统的大型语言模型（LLM）由于其计算和内存需求，通常不适合连续的设备端行为预测。此外，行为模式具有高度的个人化和设备特异性，这促使采用能够保护隐私和数据主权的本地处理方式。小型语言模型（SLM）提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但它们在低级别顺序交互事件上进行可靠推理的能力仍未得到充分探索。本研究引入了证据驱动的本地行为预测（ELBP），这是一种四层架构，结合了确定性交互处理、双视图行为表示、SLM（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为ELBP的四层证据驱动本地行为预测架构，利用小型语言模型在设备端预测用户未来的辅助使用需求，在保护隐私的同时满足高风险环境下的及时响应要求。
en_tdlr: This study introduces ELBP, a four-layer evidence-grounded local behavioral prediction architecture that leverages small language models for on-device prediction of future assistance use, balancing privacy preservation with timely response in high-stakes environments.
